This reference is generated from the running Spring Boot WebFlux application in CI. It documents the stable dashboard contract, JWT Bearer authentication, structured error responses, and the fallback behavior exposed to the React client.

Bearer JWT Use Swagger UI locally with the Authorize button, or pass Authorization: Bearer <token>.
